notes: The title states Errors in 1st 100 pages of notes + letter to Quillen. There is no date or manuscript page number. The lower-left 16 is archive foliation and is preserved only as a comment.

The Quillen-letter section has five correction entries, referring to page 5, page 5 prime and page 6 prime. It proposes Commute with, standard, the article the, and the plural categories. The longer p.5 line 15 wording is only said to be more normal.

The Reflections section has twelve page-and-line entries, covering references to pages 1 through 41. The p.5 manifold suggestion is qualified as more usual, and the p.21 n-tuples entry says is I believe correct.

At p.32 line 17 the suggested term is probably modelizer, with one opening quote stroke and paired closing strokes. The p.34 entry calls which allow unclear in sense; it discusses which allow one to but says that this does not seem to be right here, then distinguishes Allow for.

The final entry prefers we have to we got and calls the latter American, linking that observation by a three-dot therefore sign to 16th and 17th century English. The small connector between those ordinals remains ambiguous between or and an ampersand; no historical claim is verified here.
